name: Fuentes de Nava (Spain)
description: Divided horizontally by an embattled line, red above with a white fountain at the upper hoist and white below with a red fountain at the lower hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Fuentes de Nava; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: fountain on the red at the upper hoist
fountain on the white at the lower hoist
